title: Core Clock - ASTRA implemented cinematic launch/title pages
author: mggriebz

comments.author: mggriebz
comments.body:
The stars feel aligned with ASTRA release and me finally willing to try Godot + Blender.

I still have basically 0 experience with either, but the MCP allows me to vaguely understand tools and still get the most-use out of them without diving into the "tool" itself (godot engine/blender/etc.). Codex LUNA for most execution with Sol or Opus/Sonnet making PRD planning docs usually first.

It's been a little over 6 weeks since I self-committed to building a "game" and largely contribute the open/kind natured community here at /aigamedev for helping me push myself and enjoy the time/output. <3 ty all <3

Note:
I use several free assets to help speed up the process (shout out to KayKit packs) but also use ClaudeDesign and the 3D model skill in some cases such as the clock tower. Shout out to @Will_X_Intent for his Tripo credits and inspiring the puck objects/design.

Still a long way to go... but having fun building and wanted to share. Thanks for reading =)
